reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year, so paying ₹12,990 upfront for our 3 to 5 person firm feels steep when established tools cost half as much. Even though I love modern apps and want client intake automation, I would only test the free pilot first to see if the workflow genuinely justifies paying double before committing.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive, and does its intake automation genuinely save enough time to warrant double the price?
would_change_my_mind: Pricing competitive with Jamku around ₹7,000 to ₹8,000 a year, or hands-on proof during the free pilot that the WhatsApp bridge and auto-filing seamlessly automate our intake without extra manual work.
